product_metadata.title: Carolina Candle Leather & Tobacco Scented Jar Candle, Finch & Vine Collection, 3 Wick, 14.5 oz - Up to 60 Hours Burn
features: WARMTH | The luscious notes of tobacco leaf are enhanced by the aroma of honeysuckle and the warmth of birch and incense.
SOOTHING | The first whiff of the fragrance tickles your senses with the sweet floral notes of honeysuckle to calm your mood.
FRAGRANCE | Top: Raspberry, Lily Of The Valley, Honeysuckle Middle: Tobacco Leaves, Silver Birch, Incense Bottom: Leather, Vanilla Bean, Musk
BURN | Featuring three cotton wicks, this soy wax blend candle is filled with rustic inspired fragrance to make your house a home.
EXPERTLY CRAFTED | This 14.5 ounce candle from the Carolina Farmhouse collection is proudly poured in the USA.
description: Create a comforting ambience with fragrances from the Farmhouse Collection by Carolina Candle that feel just like home. With its delicious blend of fragrance, Leather & Tobacco creates an ambience that will pull you in and wrap you up in the warming embrace of a comforting aroma. Leather & Tobacco permeates your home with the sweet woody scent of tobacco leaf, birch and incense. It transports you to a place of luxurious warmth. The Farmhouse Collection by Carolina draws inspiration from handcrafted elements which turn your house into a rustic hideaway through fragrances of apple, cinnamon, blackberry, cedarwood and more. Turn your house into a home with the Farmhouse Collection.
